name: Narrated Explainer Video (Japanese / HyperFrames)
description: Script → pronunciation lint → Kokoro narration (governed voice op) → whisper round-trip verification → subtitle timing sync → hyperframes check → preview approval → render → ffprobe verify. Follows knowledge/product/orchestration/japanese-voiceover-production-playbook.md.

context.script_text: Replace with the narration script. Write readings in kana for anything risky: エーアイ not AI, だいさんい not 第3位, みっつ not 3つ.

params.cmd: {{python_bin}} -c "from misaki.ja import JAG2P; g=JAG2P(version='cutlet'); [print(g(l.strip())[0]) for l in open('{{script_path}}') if l.strip()]" > {{work_dir}}/g2p-lint.txt && cat {{work_dir}}/g2p-lint.txt

params.input: Review {{work_dir}}/g2p-lint.txt against the intended readings of {{script_path}}. Any Latin alphabet fragment left unphonemized or counter misread (e.g. 第3位 → だいさんくらい) must be fixed by rewriting the token in kana/katakana in the script before continuing. Rules: knowledge/product/orchestration/japanese-voiceover-production-playbook.md §1. Do NOT propose switching JAG2P to version='pyopenjtalk' (verified degraded on Kokoro-82M-4bit).

params.cmd: {{python_bin}} -c "import mlx_whisper,json; r=mlx_whisper.transcribe('{{narration_path}}',path_or_hf_repo='{{whisper_model}}',language='ja',verbose=False); json.dump([{'start':s['start'],'end':s['end'],'text':s['text']} for s in r['segments']],open('{{timings_path}}','w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1); print(json.dumps(r['segments'] and [{'t':s['text']} for s in r['segments']],ensure_ascii=False))"

params.input: Compare the transcript in {{timings_path}} against {{script_path}} intended readings. Latin 'AI'/'LLM' in the transcript means the katakana reading was spoken correctly; a kana rendering or wrong word means the script needs more kana — fix the script and re-run from generate_narration. Only proceed when every segment reads as intended.

Update {{project_dir}}/index.html so each subtitle clip's data-start/data-duration matches the segment bounds in {{timings_path}}; set root data-duration to audio length + 0.3s and the audio element's to the audio length; re-time GSAP beats (kicker pops, pulses) to just before each segment start. See playbook §4.

Run `cd {{project_dir}} && npx hyperframes preview --background`, hand the Studio URL to the operator, and proceed only after the operator accepts the picture and narration. Rendering without an explicit accept violates the review gate (playbook §6).
